data.name: ObsConnectionHint
data.value: Address, port and password from OBS → Tools → WebSocket Server Settings

data.name: HostTip
data.value: 127.0.0.1 for this PC. For another PC, its IP address or domain name (the OBS port must be forwarded on the remote router).

data.name: AutoConnect
data.value: Connect and start the caption server when the app starts

data.name: AutoConnectTip
data.value: When you connect, the password is kept encrypted with this Windows user account. Leave it empty to use the saved password.

data.name: BrowserUrlTip
data.value: Add it to the OBS camera scene as a browser source, above the camera source, the size of the canvas.

data.name: AddSource
data.value: Add the caption source to OBS

data.name: AddSourceTip
data.value: Puts the caption browser source at the top of the current OBS program scene, the size of the canvas. Press it again in another scene to put the same source there too.

data.name: SourceNameTip
data.value: Name of an OBS source to show or hide along with it (optional)

data.name: SceneKeysHint
data.value: Scene shortcuts (Ctrl+Alt+1~4) · type the scene names and press Connect to save them

data.name: PptTuningHint
data.value: Only needed when the lyrics were read wrong or to send another text box.

data.name: SaveCue
data.value: Save the corrected text of this slide

data.name: SaveCueTip
data.value: Uses the text corrected above as this slide's caption (when the lyrics were read wrong).

data.name: CameraSourceTip
data.value: The camera source's name exactly as the OBS source list shows it

data.name: RecoveryHint
data.value: If the app closed suddenly, brings back this service's draft, order and caption choice.
